claudeMdBody.intro: Loaded into Claude Code's context at every session start. Keep it focused — every token here is a token less for the conversation.
claudeMdBody.absent: No CLAUDE.md found at the project root or in .claude/.

settingsBody.intro: settings.json defines model, permissions, env and hooks for the project. settings.local.json is your private override (gitignored).
settingsBody.localOverrideDetail: Your settings.local.json overrides {{count}} field(s): {{fields}}. This file is gitignored.

rulesBody.intro: Rules are markdown files that apply only when their scope matches the file Claude is working on. They stack — multiple rules can apply.
rulesBody.totalTokens: {{tokens}} tokens combined when all are active.

skillsBody.intro: Skills are reusable agent procedures. Audit, eval, and iteration tools live in the dedicated Skills tab.

commandsBody.intro: Commands are mono-file prompts you trigger by typing /name in Claude Code.

outputStylesBody.intro: Output styles let you switch how Claude responds — concise, verbose, review mode, etc.

agentsBody.intro: Subagents are specialized agents the main Claude can delegate to. They run in a separate context.

mcpBody.intro: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers expose external tools to Claude. Defined in .mcp.json at the project root.
mcpBody.absent: No .mcp.json found at the project root.

hooksBody.intro: Hooks are shell commands Claude Code runs at specific lifecycle events.

events.SessionStart: Runs once at the start of a session.
events.UserPromptSubmit: Runs when the user sends a message. Use to add context or refuse.
events.PreToolUse: Runs before any tool the agent calls. Use to gate, log, or prepare.
events.PostToolUse: Runs after a tool succeeds. Use to format, lint, or react to side effects.
events.Notification: Runs when Claude Code wants to surface a notification.
events.Stop: Runs when the agent finishes a turn.
events.SessionEnd: Runs once at the end of a session.
